title: Contractor profit and ply waste

scenes.vo: Har kuch slab pe naya ply? Sara munafa yahin phas gaya.

scenes.video_prompt: Handheld vertical phone footage on an Indian RCC construction site in bright natural daylight. A lean Indian construction worker effortlessly lifts and carries a large light-grey plastic sheet across the slab. The sheet is 8 by 4 feet, 12 mm thick, completely plain light grey on both faces with no logos, stickers, or text. The hollow edge shows small round holes in two staggered rows. Raw realistic documentary look, no text overlays.
